data.name: 未了情书
data.detailed_description:
Game Story

In Taisho-era Tokyo—a romantic age where neon lights intertwined with kimono-clad figures—barmaid Machida Keiko met Kajiwara Yusuke, an abstract painter known as the "painting madman." Everyone mocked his incomprehensible works. Only Keiko, standing before his canvas, felt her eyes grow warm and whispered the words that made him look at her for the very first time: "I see it… a sunset about to fade away in your painting."

A love letter sealed for years suddenly unearths a past they had both long forgotten. They had met before—many years ago, beneath falling cherry blossoms, a timid girl and a misunderstood boy once shared a brief glance, and a letter that was never sent. Keiko was too afraid to speak; Yusuke was too silent to express himself. So those feelings were buried among old papers and left untouched for years. Now, reunited by fate, they slowly draw closer amid the warmth of the izakaya and the scent of paint in the studio. Yet time, misunderstandings, and their own fears continue to test them.

This is a letter that arrived far too late. It is also a story of missed chances and reconciliation—when cherry blossoms fall once more, will those unspoken words finally find their way, word by word, into each other's hearts?

Game Features

  • Authentic Japanese Atmosphere – Immersive Taisho Romance

The author has meticulously researched the cultural details of the Taisho era, striving to recreate that enchanting time when Western and Japanese cultures collided. From kimono patterns to corner cafes, from the warmth of the izakaya to the scent of the art studio, every detail softly whispers: Welcome back to Taisho.

  • Exclusive Art – Crafted with Heart

Over 20 exclusive CG illustrations, character sprites, cover art—all original and custom-made. The delicate, beautiful art style captures each character's most heartfelt moments. The words left unsaid… are hidden within the images.

  • Japanese Voice Acting – A Sound That Touches the Soul

Partial Japanese voice acting brings the characters to life. With captivating vocal performances, when those deeply buried words reach your ears in gentle tones, you may find yourself believing in the power of love once more.

  • Multiple Endings – Every Choice Comes from the Heart

Three romanceable routes, each leading to multiple endings. Every story is a unique journey of the heart. Your choices determine where love ultimately arrives.

Gameplay

  • Branching Choices + Affection System – Certain choices affect character affection levels, which in turn unlock different endings.

  • Main Story Progression – Follow the first-person perspective of the protagonist Machida Keiko through the main story, advancing to various locations such as Jinbocho, Fujiya Hotel, an abandoned shrine, and Ginza galleries to unlock new storylines, character dialogues, and narrative foreshadowing.

  • Ending Gallery – After clearing routes, unlocked endings can be accessed directly from the main menu's "Extras" section for easy review.

  • Voice Collection Unlock – Progressing through the main story unlocks corresponding voice clips for each male lead. Divided into two voice collections, these can be revisited at any time from the voice menu to replay character lines and literary reading segments.

Characters

【Protagonist】 Machida Keiko

An ordinary girl working at an izakaya. She dropped out of school to support her family after her mother fell ill. Gentle and soft-spoken, she is the classic Japanese "Yamato Nadeshiko" type—and the only person who truly understands Kajiwara's paintings.

【Main Love Interest】 Kajiwara Yusuke

A niche abstract painter. His fame stems not from his art, but from his strikingly handsome face. Eccentric and lost in his own world, he is dismissed as a "painting madman." He has a romantic history but remains "pure in body."

【Love Interest】 Takeishi Kyutaro

The owner and head chef of the izakaya. Warm and considerate, he once encouraged Keiko to take a crucial step forward in her life. Gentle and kind, he offers Keiko the warmth of family.

【Love Interest】 Yoshinari Yuji

Kajiwara's assistant—a high school student who mustered the courage to learn painting from him. A growing, evolving character with a sunny and hardworking personality.

data.short_description: In Taisho-era Tokyo,Machida Keiko meets three men who change her fate—painter Kajiwara Yusuke who speaks to her soul, chef Takeishi Kyutaro who guards her gently, and boy Yoshinari Yuji who grows alongside her. Three paths, one heart—your choice decides where love finally arrives.
